package storetranslatefixture

import (
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/ast"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/core"
)

// A comparable helper with no rule for Node: reported.
func firstNonZeroNode(a, b *ast.Node) *ast.Node {
	return core.FirstNonZero(a, b)
}

type checker struct{}

// A key struct whose node is read back: not a key only, reported.
type readBackKey struct {
	node *ast.Node
	flag bool
}

func (c *checker) readBack(m map[readBackKey]int, node *ast.Node) *ast.Node {
	for k := range m {
		if k.flag {
			return k.node
		}
	}
	m[readBackKey{node, true}] = 1
	return nil
}

// A list passed where the Pointer takes a slice, to a function without a
// List version: reported.
func count(nodes []*ast.Node) int { return len(nodes) }

func countArguments(node *ast.Node) int {
	return count(node.Arguments())
}

// A lone XxxData(): reported (4.1).
func isFunctionLike(node *ast.Node) bool {
	return node.FunctionLikeData() != nil
}

// The keys of a map keyed by a node read back: reported.
func keysOf(m map[*ast.Node]int) []*ast.Node {
	var out []*ast.Node
	for k := range m {
		out = append(out, k)
	}
	return out
}

// R8 without a factory: reported.
func noFactory(node *ast.Node, parent *ast.Node) {
	node.Parent = parent
}

// R8 with two factories: reported.
type two struct {
	a ast.NodeFactory
	b *ast.NodeFactory
}

func (t *two) twoFactories(node *ast.Node, parent *ast.Node) {
	node.Parent = parent
}
